children: reported record fiscal third-quarter results for the period ended August 31, 2026, with revenue of $21.6 billion, a 37.7% year-over-year increase, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.68, up 58.7% year over year. GAAP net income was $416 million and diluted EPS was $5.18 for the quarter. The company also announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.48 per share and returned $139 million to stockholders via repurchases and dividends.
Revenue: $21,558 million for Q3 FY26, up 37.7% year over year from $15,651 million.
Gross profit: $1,425 million for Q3 FY26; gross margin 6.61% (down 61 bps year over year).
Operating income: GAAP operating income $643 million for Q3 FY26 (up 67.6% year over year).
Net income and EPS: GAAP net income $416 million; diluted EPS $5.18 for Q3 FY26.
Non-GAAP results: Non-GAAP operating income $736 million and non-GAAP diluted EPS $5.68 for Q3 FY26 (non-GAAP operating margin 3.42%).
Volume growth: Non-GAAP gross billings were $31,828 million in Q3 FY26, a 40.0% increase year over year, exceeding outlook.
Channel performance: Both Distribution and Hyve businesses performed above expectations and outpaced market growth.
Market trends: Ongoing enterprise AI adoption and data center modernization were cited as drivers expanding opportunities across Distribution and Hyve.

Capital allocation: Returned $139 million to stockholders in the quarter via approximately $100 million of share repurchases and $38 million in dividends; announced a 9% year-over-year increase in the quarterly cash dividend to $0.48 per share.
Outlook: For Q4 FY26 the company expects revenue of $21.8–$22.6 billion and non-GAAP gross billings of $31.4–$32.4 billion, and estimates non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.65–$6.15.
